input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 4) changepoint-detector: a trend-aware Middle for counts
errors: First candidate (ungated robust slope) alerted on flat probe sites (3,1,1 vs Middle's 2,0,0); added a BIC gate before the round, recorded in the prereg.
Gate first compared against an infinite NB size (negbinSize returns Infinity on unclumped counts) and read an undefined cost from poissonTrend's out(); both fixed before the round.

doc_friction.issue: Stop hook demands committing untracked files while a long eval is still writing its output file; used .git/info/exclude locally until the run finished.
9,000+ lines; finding the section that named this item needed grep on headings, the flagship row pointed to it by title, which worked.

deviations.why: The previous section suggested a slow fitted level (rolling median); I tested a gated robust log-linear growth term instead, because the engine already had it and a rolling level would likely absorb the fall it should hear (not measured).
deviations.result: failed H1 (6.25 vs bar 3.83 alerts/1,000 days on 30%-growth sites), passed H2-H4; ships as an option

notes: Round eval/middle-trend.mjs, 67 min on 4 cores, fresh seeds. H fails on H1 only; G fails G4 (narrowly) and G6. Defaults unchanged; --trend robust added to engine/CLI/watch with trendNote when the gate drops it.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design, implement and run a pre-registered simulation round with a new estimator option, plus write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
